settings.identity_policy: Fixed feature locations in all eight views; never duplicate a front facade on a rear view. Labels are source camera names, not inferred runtime headings.
settings.brief: An ordinary compact single-storey home, higher white left volume and lower charcoal right entry volume. Asymmetrical stepped flat parapet roofs, timber front door and six rectangular solar modules in two rows of three on the higher roof. No science-fiction canopy, no huge glazing walls, no mansion scale.
